TaskActivity.description:
Neglect signal derived from the task's whole history (classification
version 2). A task is inactive for N days exactly when `not_after` is
at or before the evaluation instant minus N days. `pending` is a
transport-only status: the server has not yet processed every event
of the task, so the evidence fields are null or empty. Never use a
`pending` or `bounded` task as evidence of recent activity.

last_meaningful_at.description: Last qualifying activity; set only when `known`.

source.description: Qualifying source such as `human.comment`; empty unless `known`.

not_after.description: Latest possible time of meaningful activity; equals `last_meaningful_at` when `known`; null when `unknown` or `pending`.

reason.description: Why a `bounded` or `unknown` result is not exact; empty otherwise.

classification_version.description: Classifier version of the stored result; null when `pending`.

TaskActivityCoverage.description:
Present only on neglect listings. `complete` is true only when every
event of the project up to the request's snapshot is processed, every
live task of the project has a current result, and no returned task is
`pending`; otherwise the listing is not the full answer and tasks may
be missing from it. A page chain whose first page is complete is gap-
and duplicate-free; a project write between pages returns
`409 task_collection_changed`.

lag.description: Event cursors of this project not yet processed.

pending.description: Tasks on this page returned with status `pending`.
